findings.title: Birth, Fosterage, and Descent
findings.claim: Within the surah's birth and aftermath frame, the sworn self can be heard as a living beginning that enters dependence and descent; its proportioning is a formed condition within a line that can continue beyond one individual.
findings.mechanism: The focus birth facet of the indefinite self meets the pericope's following, fosterage, household, and posterity images. Their contact changes a static picture of formation into entry into a dependent and generational sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: Formation becomes perceptible as the beginning of a life that receives care and carries continuation, while the ordinary living-self reading remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-bounded generational resonance. It does not make the focus noun literally mean lineage, and the omitted context branch records are not independently asserted as lexical carriers.

epistemic.reason: Trusted pericope review supplies the candidate image and exact focus carriers; the interpretive contact with the whole-surah context remains a bounded macro inference.

findings.title: Camel Handling and Riding
findings.claim: The formed self can be pictured as an embodied carrier whose movement depends on fitted support, management, and an easy release into motion.
findings.mechanism: The focus riding-pad facet of the proportioning verb meets the pericope's roused and managed she-camel, covering, and smooth-gait imagery. The contact turns proportion from abstract symmetry into adaptive fitting for a living carrier.
